CBI finds no evidence against Sanjeev Mukhiya in NEET-UG paper leak

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has stated that its investigation into the 2024 NEET-UG paper leak found no evidence connecting Sanjeev Mukhiya, identified as a main suspect, to the theft or distribution of the question paper. The agency has filed chargesheets against 45 individuals involved in the conspiracy. The CBI's probe identified the entire conspiracy behind the leak.
